header: What the search line needs to know about this topic (pure, no React): the words that ask for the full calculator, a number typed in a base (0xFF, 255 to binary), and a typed sum that I answer as you type (12*45+7, 15% of 2400, 5 lakh * 12). How it looks in the panel is in ui.tsx; its logic is in the files beside this one. I list it once, in src/tools/registry.ts.
